messages.ko: 오늘은 주빈이 생일. 모두 축하 해주셨나요?
messages.en: Today's Joobin's birthday. Did everyone wish her a happy birthday?
It's been
years since Joobin was born.

messages.ko: 주빈이는 현제 일반고가 아니라 고등학교 입학 개념은 아니지만
messages.en: Since Joobin isn't attending a regular high school, it doesn't really feel like she's entering high school,
but by age, she's officially become a high school student.
Can you believe it? Our little Joobin is a high school student now.
I still can't believe it.
Joobin has always been someone who
gives her all to whatever she's responsible for,
and she's grown so much because of it.
As someone who's watched her from the closest,

messages.ko: 남들이 성숙하고 어른스러운 아이이다 다큰것같다 라는 이야기를 하지만
messages.en: people often say she's mature, grown-up, and very adult-like,

messages.ko: 사실은 마음이 아주여리고 여느 또래와같이 지나가는 낙엽에 웃기도하고 울기도하는 그런 아이입니다
messages.en: but in reality, she's very soft-hearted. Just like anyone her age, she'll laugh at a falling leaf one moment and cry the next.
*Sniff sniff.*
Sometimes I wonder if she thinks I'm the younger one,
because she acts like the older sister all the time,
but she's still such an adorable little sister.
(That's right....)
Please continue to stay with us.

messages.ko: 좋은 말씀 중에 잠시 재채기 좀 하겠습니다
messages.en: Excuse me, I'll just sneeze for a moment during your wonderful speech.
Achoo~~~
Bless you.
Anyway, once again, happy birthday to our friend Joobin.

messages.ko: 맞다 요즘 독감유행하는데 다들 조심하시고 건강하십시오
messages.en: Oh right, the flu's been going around lately, so everyone please stay healthy and take care.
Hayeon, your birthday isn't too far away either~
Excuse me? It's still eight months away...
Thank you though.
Wait, isn't it August right now?
Did you come from the past or the future?

messages.ko: 나만 이 흐름에 못 따라가는 걸까 혹시
messages.en: Am I the only one who's lost here?
What if I told you there wasn't any flow to begin with?
One moment!
I've picked out a gift that Joobin wants!
It's a Chunsik bowl.
I actually put this on my birthday wishlist too,
and I remember hoping so badly that I'd receive it!!
Haha... that's a little embarrassing.
Hayeon, is there anything you want to receive this year?!
Hmm...
What if I said... Y/n?
Where'd you go?
I got embarrassed and ran away.
Your usual way of talking is finally back.
Huh!!!!
Hayeon, have you eaten yet?
Do not bring up food.
Ahhh... I forgot to eat.
I am currently in a state of hunger.
I thought you meant you forgot and didn't eat.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Ah, I *did* forget and didn't eat.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 야 그럼 빨리 밥 먹어 하연아
messages.en: Then hurry up and go eat, Hayeon.
What do you want? Dakbokkeumtang? Chicken feet?ㅋㄹ
Don't do this to me!!

messages.ko: 아 오늘 처음 채팅시작했는데 이방은 이런 분위기인가? 하고 당황중이었자나!
messages.en: Ah, I just joined the chat today and was wondering, 'Is this what this chatroom is always like?' I was so confused!
This is how this place normally is!!

messages.ko: 07즈 중에 제일 조신할거라 생각했는데... 내가 크게 헛발질을 했고마잉...
messages.en: I thought you'd be the most well-mannered among the '07 liners... I was completely wrong...
That wasn't a misunderstanding.
My hobby is reading.
What was
your reason
for becoming a Hayeon fan?
That's what I'd ask.
I didn't just become a Hayeon fan... I've become Hayeon herself.
A doppelgänger!!!!!!

messages.ko: 요즘 당신은 김채원 얘기를 많이 안 하는데 헤어졌습니까?
messages.en: You haven't talked much about Kim Chaewon lately... did you two break up?
We don't get to use the practice room together very often...
So we don't get to see each other that much...
Where am I?
By any chance,
what year is it right now?
Are you two in a long-distance relationship?
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
So we were dating after all.

messages.ko: 하지만 여러분은 베스트 커플 후보에 오르지 못했습니다..
messages.en: Unfortunately, you two weren't nominated for Best Couple...
Oh dear.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋㅎㅋ
Now that we're talking about her, I miss her.
Me?
ㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ Uh... yeah.
I'm hungry!!!!!
I think hunger is making me lose my mind.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Chaewon says she misses you right now.
Then tell Kim Chaewon
that I want to play a word-chain game with her.
Train.
She'd probably say, 'I'll make you mine…🥀'
I'm not playing anymore.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
I'm going to get ready for bed now...
now...
Leaving your hunger behind...
Yup.
I'm going to sleep.
Sleep well,
dream of me.
Haranghae🦄
